nodes.description: Public address state variable that receives the raised funds via send().
Public uint state variable holding the funding goal in wei.
Public uint state variable accumulating contributed wei; reset to 0 after payout.
Public uint state variable holding the crowdsale end time derived from now.
Public uint state variable with the ether cost of each reward token.
Token contract instance used to distribute reward tokens.
Public mapping tracking each backer's contributed balance.
Bool flag indicating whether the funding goal was reached.
Bool flag used in the fallback require to stop contributions.
Constructor that initializes beneficiary, goal, deadline, price and token contract.
Payable fallback function that accepts ether, credits balances, transfers tokens and sends funds to the beneficiary.
Caller identity taken from msg.sender, used for balance accounting and token transfer.
Block timestamp read via now when computing the crowdsale deadline.
balanceOf[msg.sender] += amount; unchecked addition that can overflow.
amountRaised += amount; unchecked addition that can overflow.
amount / price; unchecked division that reverts or misprices if price is zero.
External call tokenReward.transfer(msg.sender, amount / price) with unchecked return value.
External call beneficiary.send(amountRaised) executed before amountRaised is zeroed.
Constructor parameter assigned to beneficiary.
Constructor parameter multiplied by 1 ether and assigned to fundingGoal.
Constructor parameter used to compute the deadline from now.
Constructor parameter assigned to price after multiplying by 1 ether.
Constructor parameter cast to the token interface for tokenReward.
Local variable amount = msg.value inside the fallback function.

edges.reason: msg.sender indexes the balanceOf mapping that is incremented without overflow protection.
Local amount is added to balanceOf[msg.sender] and can overflow.
Local amount is added to the amountRaised state variable and can overflow.
The unchecked addition result is written back into the amountRaised state variable.
The unchecked addition writes into the balanceOf mapping.
amountRaised is sent to the beneficiary through an external call before state is reset.
beneficiary.send can re-enter the fallback before amountRaised is set to 0, allowing repeated payouts.
beneficiary state variable is the destination of the external send call.
tokenReward contract instance is the target of the external transfer call.
msg.sender is the receiver of the reward token transfer.
Result of amount / price is passed as the token amount to transfer.
Local amount is the numerator of the unchecked division by price.
price is the divisor; a zero price causes a division failure and mispricing.
The deadline is computed from now (block.timestamp), making the crowdsale time dependent on miner-controlled time.
Constructor assigns the beneficiary state variable.
Constructor assigns the fundingGoal state variable.
Constructor assigns the deadline state variable.
Constructor assigns the price state variable.
Constructor assigns the tokenReward state variable.
Constructor parameter ifSuccessfulSendTo flows into beneficiary.
Constructor parameter fundingGoalInEthers flows into fundingGoal after multiplication.
Constructor parameter durationInMinutes flows into the deadline computation.
Constructor parameter etherCostOfEachToken flows into price after multiplication.
Constructor parameter addressOfTokenUsedAsReward is cast into tokenReward.
Fallback function executes the balanceOf update.
Fallback function executes the amountRaised update.
Fallback function triggers the reward token transfer.
Fallback function performs the external send to the beneficiary, exposing the reentrancy path.
crowdsaleClosed state variable gates the require check in the fallback.
An external msg.sender invokes the payable fallback function.
Contribution acceptance in the fallback is not restricted by the timestamp-derived deadline.

normalization_plan.reason: Constructor parameter ifSuccessfulSendTo is only used to initialize the beneficiary state variable inside the Crowdsale constructor.
Constructor parameter fundingGoalInEthers is only used to compute and store fundingGoal inside the Crowdsale constructor.
Constructor parameter durationInMinutes is only used to compute the deadline inside the Crowdsale constructor.
Constructor parameter etherCostOfEachToken is only used to compute and store price inside the Crowdsale constructor.
Constructor parameter addressOfTokenUsedAsReward is only used to instantiate tokenReward inside the Crowdsale constructor.
Local variable amount is declared and consumed entirely within the payable fallback function that credits it to balanceOf and amountRaised.
